scope: Static native Oak.ApiConnection.Send* route literals and current source dispatch declarations; no game requests issued.
limitations: A route literal is a candidate API endpoint, not a reconstructed backend contract.
Literal key candidates are hints, not validated request fields or types. An empty list does not establish a parameterless request.
Registered dispatch does not establish full functionality, APK verification or complete condition/data coverage.
Constructed/delegated routes, non-Send methods, Lua and ILFix updates are outside this scan.
Response schemas, official server rules and a percentage of game completion cannot be inferred from these counts.
